# CMRR Layer fMRI Hands on tutorial

This dataset consists of one mani participant from one session. There are other cases included for reference.
The purpose of this dataset it to serve as an educational example for the Minnesota Workshop 2019 

The different runs refer to high-resolution EPI acquired at the 7T from Scanexus in Maastricht and the 7T from FMRIF at NIH. 
The protocol pdfs are here: https://github.com/layerfMRI/Sequence_Github/tree/master/CMRR_training_scann_protocol_pdfs
